## Architecture check

Applicable guides: [reviewing.md](https://github.com/safe-global/safe-client-gateway/blob/main/docs/agents/reviewing.md), [remarks.md](https://github.com/safe-global/safe-client-gateway/blob/main/docs/agents/remarks.md), [best-practices.md](https://github.com/safe-global/safe-client-gateway/blob/main/docs/agents/best-practices.md), [caching-and-performance.md](https://github.com/safe-global/safe-client-gateway/blob/main/docs/agents/caching-and-performance.md), [configuration-and-flags.md](https://github.com/safe-global/safe-client-gateway/blob/main/docs/agents/configuration-and-flags.md), [nestjs-patterns.md](https://github.com/safe-global/safe-client-gateway/blob/main/docs/agents/nestjs-patterns.md), [testing.md](https://github.com/safe-global/safe-client-gateway/blob/main/docs/agents/testing.md), [commits-and-prs.md](https://github.com/safe-global/safe-client-gateway/blob/main/docs/agents/commits-and-prs.md).

1. **[No scope creep](https://github.com/safe-global/safe-client-gateway/blob/main/docs/agents/reviewing.md#L31)** — [src/datasources/circuit-breaker/circuit-breaker.service.ts:376](https://github.com/safe-global/safe-client-gateway/blob/8343e99fd89ddbefd40030ec99e0e9f38a6b45bd/src/datasources/circuit-breaker/circuit-breaker.service.ts#L376) — moving circuit registration into `recordFailure` (plus making `getOrRegisterCircuit` private, gating `recordSuccess` on `enabled` at [:292](https://github.com/safe-global/safe-client-gateway/blob/8343e99fd89ddbefd40030ec99e0e9f38a6b45bd/src/datasources/circuit-breaker/circuit-breaker.service.ts#L292), and dropping the call site at [network.module.ts:153](https://github.com/safe-global/safe-client-gateway/blob/8343e99fd89ddbefd40030ec99e0e9f38a6b45bd/src/datasources/network/network.module.ts#L153)) is a registration-lifecycle change the probe cap does not depend on. **Fix:** keep `public getOrRegisterCircuit`, restore `const circuit = this.circuits.get(name); if (!(this.enabled && circuit) || circuit.metrics.state === CircuitState.OPEN) { return; }` in `recordFailure`, restore `circuitBreakerService.getOrRegisterCircuit(circuitBreaker.key);` in `network.module.ts`, and ship lazy registration as its own PR.
2. **[Allowed types](https://github.com/safe-global/safe-client-gateway/blob/main/docs/agents/commits-and-prs.md#L29)** — PR title — `feat` is reserved for a new client-visible capability, while this corrects the HALF_OPEN behavior behind the 2026-09-09 outage, which the type table assigns to `fix`. **Fix:** retitle to `fix(circuit-breaker): cap in-flight probes while HALF_OPEN`.
3. **[R-029: A PR carrying more than one concern](https://github.com/safe-global/safe-client-gateway/blob/main/docs/agents/remarks.md#L435)** — [src/datasources/circuit-breaker/circuit-breaker.service.spec.ts:19](https://github.com/safe-global/safe-client-gateway/blob/8343e99fd89ddbefd40030ec99e0e9f38a6b45bd/src/datasources/circuit-breaker/circuit-breaker.service.spec.ts#L19) — the suite-wide switch to `vi.useFakeTimers()` rewrites rolling-window, stale-cleanup and metrics tests that never exercise a probe, adding a second concern to the diff. **Fix:** scope `vi.useFakeTimers()` to the HALF_OPEN describe block the new probe tests live in, or land the suite conversion separately as `test(circuit-breaker): move the suite to fake timers`.
4. **[R-004: Literal test data instead of faker](https://github.com/safe-global/safe-client-gateway/blob/main/docs/agents/remarks.md#L90)** — [src/datasources/circuit-breaker/circuit-breaker.service.spec.ts:485](https://github.com/safe-global/safe-client-gateway/blob/8343e99fd89ddbefd40030ec99e0e9f38a6b45bd/src/datasources/circuit-breaker/circuit-breaker.service.spec.ts#L485) — the new `recordSuccess` test passes the literal `new-circuit` although nothing in the assertion depends on that value and the suite already has a faker-backed name. **Fix:** use `service.recordSuccess(circuitName); expect(service.get(circuitName)).toBeUndefined();`.

**Verdict:** ❌ 4 finding(s)
